title: every time i end up in the school i see little me
content: there’s a building in my mall world that looks like a post apocalyptic abandoned building, but it’s layout and some obscure features like glass patterns on the walls in the stairwell all come from my real life elementary school. it’s very vague, very intuitive. there’s one section on the ground floor that’s a bathroom no one is allowed to use. it’s enormous, there is a maze constructed of functional bathroom items like toilets, sinks, stall doors, and stall walls. but once you get to the other end of the bathroom, you reach an exit that puts you into a gated park that is otherwise impossible to access. it feels so hidden that it makes me afraid. i have a constant feeling like i’m not supposed to be there as soon as i get to the park, but even if i go back into the school i still feel panicked. and then i’ll see me. the first time was brief, i was coming downstairs with the rest of my class. just looking around. maybe 3 years old. when i saw me last night, i was maybe 6 years old. i asked me, “do you know who i am?” she answered, but i didn’t understand her. i want to know what she said. for some reason these are some of the most distressing dreams i have. i never choose to go there, i just get dropped in there. but once i’m there i’m so drawn to the park and getting to the park. in another dream i have, there’s also a certain mysterious place that i am fixated on getting to. i very rarely make it to either— i’ll be distracted or the dream will get cut short somehow.
